remarks: LOCATION! Enjoy the beauty of waterfront living in this spacious townhouse, just the second house from the water in the highly sought-after Shippan neighborhood. This property features two large bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and an open floor plan designed for modern living. The updated kitchen offers a sleek, newer design perfect for entertaining. Step outside to your private outdoor spaces, with a large deck on the second floor that overlooks the water, and a larger deck on the first floor leading to a spacious yard, ideal for relaxation or gatherings. The unbeatable location, just steps from the water, makes this home a rare find.  Great Credit, income, references and background check are required. Pets are allowed with screening and additional fee.
